$comment: Jev semantic guards (dobby-foundation jev-semantic-guards). rails.<review|prose>.mode: off | shadow | jev is the kill-switch AND the promotion lever: one reviewed line. off = the regex-only guards exactly as before. shadow = the regex decides, Jev is asked and both are logged (.jev/decisions.jsonl + the <!-- jev: --> marker on cross-review comments); it REQUIRES shadowExpires and CI fails once it passes. jev = Jev decides; the regex decides only when Jev cannot look (no key, 429, timeout) or is unsure. No TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or egress:false, behaves exactly as off. PROMOTED 2026-09-23 (jev-semantic-guards S5.3): both rails decide with Jev at the measured thresholds — evidence in dobby-foundation Roadmap/09-platform-infra/jev-semantic-guards/shadow-report-2026-09-23.md.
